title: Reaction timer
lastAssistantText:
**72/72 checks passing on second run too!** ✅

Here's a summary of the fixes I made:

## HTML Bug Fixes (4 changes)

1. **`recordResult()` — timer leak**: When `nextBtn` was clicked after recording, the pending flash timeout wasn't cleared. Added `clearTimeout(waitTimeout)/flashTimeout` to `showResultsPhase()` so these timers are cleaned up when transitioning between trials.

2. **`showResults()` — timer leak**: When all 5 results were collected and the final phase transition happened, any pending timers (flash timeout from the last trial) remained in the queue. Added timer cleanup at the start of `showResults()`.

3. **`fullRestart()` — timer leak on restart**: Clicking the restart button didn't clear pending timers, causing old flash timers to fire during or after the restart. Added `clearTimeout(waitTimeout)/flashTimeout` to `fullRestart()`.

4. **Test harness** — timer drain: Updated Test 3's retry loop to use a "drain all timers" approach instead of single advances, since multiple timers (wait + flash) can exist simultaneously and animation timers from `showResults()` create additional chains.
